introduction.p1: This Cookie Policy explains what cookies are, how we use them on our website, and how you can manage your cookie preferences.

whatAreCookies.title: What Are Cookies?
whatAreCookies.desc: Cookies are small text files stored on your device (computer, tablet, or mobile) when you visit a website. They help websites remember your preferences and improve your browsing experience.

cookieTypes.title: Types of Cookies We Use
cookieTypes.intro: We use different types of cookies for different purposes:

necessary.title: Necessary Cookies
necessary.desc: Essential for the website to function properly. These cookies cannot be disabled as they are required for core features like security, network management, and consent preferences.
necessary.example2: Language preferences - Remembers your selected language

analytics.title: Analytics Cookies
analytics.desc: Help us understand how visitors interact with our website by collecting and reporting information anonymously. We use Google Analytics to analyze site usage.

advertising.title: Advertising Cookies
advertising.desc: Used to deliver relevant advertisements based on your interests. They also limit the number of times you see an ad and help measure advertising campaign effectiveness.
advertising.example1: IDE - Used by Google DoubleClick to register and report user actions
advertising.example2: DSID - Used to identify a signed-in user on non-Google sites

thirdParty.title: Third-Party Cookies
thirdParty.intro: Some cookies are placed by third-party services that appear on our pages:

google.title: Google (Analytics & Ads)
google.desc: We use Google Analytics to analyze website traffic and Google Ads to display relevant advertisements.

manageCookies.title: How to Manage Cookies
manageCookies.intro: You have full control over which cookies you accept:
manageCookies.method1: Use our Cookie Settings (available in the cookie banner) to customize your preferences
manageCookies.method2: Change your browser settings to block or delete cookies
manageCookies.method3: Use third-party tools to control advertising cookies

speedTestUI.title: Internet Speed Test
speedTestUI.startMessage: Click the button below to start testing your connection speed
speedTestUI.downloadDesc: Download speed measures how fast you can receive data from the internet. The higher, the better for streaming, downloads, and browsing.
speedTestUI.uploadDesc: Upload speed measures how fast you can send data to the internet. Important for video conferences, sharing files, and uploads.
speedTestUI.pingDesc: Ping measures your connection response time in milliseconds. The lower, the better for online gaming and video calls.
speedTestUI.jitterDesc: Jitter measures ping variation. Low values indicate a stable connection, important for streaming and video calls.
speedTestUI.tip1: Connect your device directly to the router via ethernet cable for faster speeds
speedTestUI.tip2: Position the router in a central and elevated location, away from walls and obstacles
speedTestUI.tip3: Close applications and downloads you're not using to free up bandwidth
speedTestUI.tip4: Restart the router regularly to clear memory and improve performance
speedTestUI.tip5: Check for available firmware updates for your router
speedTestUI.privacyText: This test runs 100% in your browser. No personal data is collected or stored. We use public Cloudflare servers to perform speed measurements.
